title: Add OCR-based Spotify statistics parsing system
body: Implemented automated screenshot parsing system using Tesseract OCR to extract Spotify analytics data from screenshots. Includes validation system with example screenshots and ground truth data.

title: Create responsive gallery with unlock game
body: Added photo gallery with tic-tac-toe unlock game. Gallery displays personal photos in a responsive grid layout.

title: Implement Spotify analytics dashboard
body: Created interactive Spotify analytics dashboard showing streaming statistics, demographics, geography, and discovery sources with visual charts and metrics.

title: Add asymptote idle game
body: Integrated the Asymptote idle game with mathematical progression mechanics and persistent game state.

title: Improve browser compatibility with vendor prefixes
body: Added vendor prefixes for maximum browser compatibility. Supports older browsers including IE11+. Added flexbox fallbacks for CSS Grid.
